You must confront this formidable force, as well as familiar foes with their own agendas, to uncover what happened inside the park.

FIGHT ALONGSIDE UNIQUE COMPANIONS
As the Division’s mission is halted by a sinister threat, you must rely on three reluctant heroes to guide you through the park. Each brings a distinct past and fighting style, ranging from a former Division agent to a battle-hardened athlete.

UNLOCK A NEW ENDGAME EXPERIENCE
Ambushed and pressured by unknown ravagers, you first enter the park fighting to survive. Once the story is complete, the balance of power shifts, allowing you to return to Central Park and dictate the fight, pursue enemies on your own terms, and tackle new challenges to earn exclusive and valuable rewards.

EXPAND YOUR SKILLS AND GEAR
By defeating Central Park’s primary threats and their twisted abilities, you can earn new powers of your own. Six new skill variants grant beast‑like skills inspired by the horrors you’ll overcome. New gear is also introduced, including a brand-new Exotic Weapon, a new gear set, and more.

games.name: While Shifu's Away: Senior Sister, I've Fallen for You!
ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut
games.summary:
Brilliant, burnt-out, possibly cursed – you play as operant Hershel Wilk, alias CASCADE. Five years ago you led your team into the abyss and have been haunted by your failures ever since. Now you've been recalled for a mysterious assignment that may give you a chance to prove yourself again.

Find yourself thrown into a three-way struggle for cultural and ideological power, played out across an unforgettable new city. In ZERO PARADES, the world itself is a character with its own secrets, traumas, and miracles for you to discover.

To get anywhere in this world, you'll need friends. Unfortunately, you don't have any. Instead, you'll go up against international bankers, foreign techno-fascists, psychic doppelgängers, a paranoid TV presenter, a man with a box for a heart, and dozens more. Everyone you meet has their own agendas, beliefs, and secrets for you to uncover and turn to your own ends.

games.name: Eternal Palace Sakura

Lightyear Frontier is an open-world farming exploration game with crafting, resource management and base building, wrapped in a mystery-driven narrative with a cosmic country soundtrack.

Play 1-4 players in online co-op, discover and grow alien plants, domesticate wildlife, endure the elements and build your new home away from home.

Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS. Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through enviro destruction

Don the robes of a cultist, perform bloody rituals and expand your influence over an army of followers in this cute yet grim world. Is your devotion strong enough to please the Old Ones?

games.name: Beautiful Women Around the World Photo Puzzle
games.summary:
A poolside photo
puzzle, anyone?

games.name: Billionaire Secret Affaire: Forbidden Desire Boys
games.summary:
In public, their lives look perfect.
Tailored suits, quiet fortunes, and men who always seem in control.

Behind closed doors, things are different.
A handshake that lasts a moment longer than it should.
A private message sent late at night.
A man who built an empire on keeping secrets… and is about to trust you with his.

In Billionaire Secret Affair: Forbidden Desire Boys, you enter an adult story about attraction between men who can't afford to be seen, and the connection that grows anyway.

These are men with names to protect. Investors, heirs, and founders who learned early that every feeling has a cost. Getting close means reading what they don't say and offering the honesty they never find anywhere else.

Every choice matters. A careful word can open a door they've kept locked for years. A careless one can send them back behind the mask for good.

Closeness grows in small, private moments. A drink after everyone leaves. A confession nobody else hears. The feeling of finally being chosen.

As the days pass, the pressure builds, reputations hang in the balance, and each man has to decide what he's willing to risk. Not every path ends in love, and not every story ends the same way.

A visual novel about desire, discretion, and the courage it takes to want someone out loud.

games.name: Billionaire Secret Affaire: Forbidden Desire Girls
games.summary:
Powerful women. Private rules. A secret only you can keep.

From the outside, their world looks untouchable.
Glass penthouses, private galas, and women who never lose their composure.

But power has its cracks.
A look that stays on you a little too long.
An invitation nobody else received.
A smile that says she's used to getting what she wants… and tonight, that might be you.

In Billionaire Secret Affaire: Forbidden Desire Girls, you're pulled into an adult story about attraction, discretion, and the price of getting too close to the wrong person.

These women run companies, fortunes, and reputations. They don't do anything by accident. Catching their attention is one thing. Keeping it without getting burned is another.

Every conversation is a test. Say too much and the door closes. Say too little and someone else takes your place. The right words at the right moment can turn a polite exchange into something neither of you can talk about in public.

Trust is earned slowly, in stolen moments and conversations that end before anyone notices.

games.name: BREACHCAM
games.summary:
EVERY BREACH IS RECORDED

BREACHCAM puts you behind the lens of a body camera worn into the fight. There is nothing clean between you and what happens: the picture bends at the edges, the sensor grains up in the dark, the frame swings with every step, and the recording marker never leaves the corner.

SIX PLACES, SIX MOODS

A hangar and a yard in flat daylight. Abandoned streets under a grey sky. Container stacks at sunset. A forest road in fog. Rail tracks and tankers in the snow at dawn. A warehouse of racks and catwalks at night.

Each one is its own deployment, with its own light, weather and layout, and you choose where to go.

CLOSE AND LOUD

You arrive carrying everything you need — rifles, a shotgun, a sidearm, grenades and a blade — so the fight starts the moment you step in. Enemy squads hold the ground, take cover and push you back when you let them, and the whole thing plays out in seconds at a distance you can measure in steps.

A RECORDING, NOT A REPORT

No maps, no markers, no briefings. Just the camera, the room in front of you, and whatever the lens catches.

games.name: Cat-Astrophy
games.summary:
Cat-Astrophy is a fast-paced, challenging space action roguelite: its Star Cursor system and evolving modules force you to adapt your build and playstyle in every run, generating chaotic combat and precise jumps. The game delivers constant tension and rewards both improvisation and technical mastery.

In each run, you’ll travel across procedurally generated planets, combining abilities, choosing paths, and mastering parkour and real-time combat mechanics. Runs are unique: find modules that alter your capabilities, discover hidden synergies, and decide whether to take risks or secure permanent upgrades with star fragments. Death is permanent: dying means learning, reconfiguring, and retrying with new strategies.

● Cosmic Procedural Exploration: Traverse different planets each run, with rooms, routes, and secrets that constantly change, forcing you to adapt your decisions on the fly.
● Agile, Strategic Combat: Use the Star Cursor to direct precise attacks while moving Polo; action is fluid, sharp, and packed with risk-reward moments.
● Unique Builds Every Run: Discover modules and reconfigure abilities to create combinations that completely transform your playstyle.
● Permanent Progression: Collect star fragments to unlock lasting upgrades that open new routes and tactical options between runs.
● Impactful Paths and Decisions: Choose which planets to explore and which rewards to pursue; your choices shape the pace and difficulty of the adventure.
● Parkour and Precision: Deadly jumps and challenging platforming sections that blend movement and combat in every encounter.
● Cosmic Pixel Art Aesthetic: Vibrant worlds, alien creatures, and environments with personality reinforce the game’s tense and frantic tone.
● Mystery-Driven Story: Discover why Polo was abducted and what forces caused the cat-astrophe; the narrative complements the action without overshadowing gameplay.

Cat-Astrophy is for players seeking intensity, replayability, and meaningful decisions. Every death teaches you something new: learn, adjust your build, and overcome what once defeated you.

games.name: Chivalware
games.summary: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

games.name: Circuit Puzzle - Brain Training: Connect the Wires -
games.summary:
Rotate the tiles. Complete the circuit!

Can you bring a scrambled circuit back to life?

Remember those simple puzzles that looked easy until you tried them? This time, a circuit board is your playground in a satisfying rotation puzzle that is easy to learn and tricky to master.

Rotate tiles covered with wires until every connection lines up correctly. One turn at a time, restore the circuit and watch the electronic board come together.

How to play:
• Observe the circuit board design
• Rotate the tiles to change their direction
• Connect the wires correctly and complete the circuit

The rules are simple, but finding the right direction takes careful observation and a spark of intuition. Seeing scattered wires join into a complete circuit delivers a wonderfully satisfying finish.

Whether you enjoy testing your focus and problem-solving skills or just want a quick brain-training break, this puzzle is a welcoming choice for beginners and experienced players alike.

Rotate each tile and bring the circuit back to life!

games.name: Dark Alley
games.summary:
Kyoto, 2013. A British detective vanishes without a trace. London sends Thomas Bennett to close the case quietly. But Kyoto doesn’t do “quiet.” Beneath red lanterns and rain-slicked alleys, Bennett finds a city built on rituals, secrets... and people willing to kill to protect them.

What starts as a missing-person investigation spirals into a dangerous web involving the Dragon Vein Yakuza, a mysterious informant, and a cold institutional presence that watches every step Bennett takes. The deeper you go through nightclubs, temples, bamboo forests and mirrored corridors, the more mystery arise around the case... until the question isn’t who took Hale, but why the truth was never meant to survive.

Dark Alley is a standalone case within the Detective Bennett: Solved Cases saga, a cinematic narrative thriller with psychological tension and dry, noir humor.

games.name: Dominus Gladiatus
games.summary: Build your Ludus. Train gladiators. Fight for glory. Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators before sending them into the arenas of ancient Rome.

games.name: Dungeon of Dragon Knight Remake
games.summary:
Dungeon Of Dragon Knight Remake
Step into a forgotten dungeon, where the echoes of ancient wars still linger. The legend of the Dragon Knight lies buried beneath its stones—and so does the Artifact that once kept the darkness at bay.

Classic Dungeon Crawling, Reborn
Dungeon Of Dragon Knight Remake is a first-person, grid-based, real-time combat dungeon crawler RPG that faithfully revives the essence of classic old-school dungeon exploration. Navigate each corridor step by step, feel the tension of every corner, and strike fast in real-time combat.

Build Your Party
Assemble a four-person adventuring party from a variety of classes and races. Each character brings unique abilities and growth paths, and every choice you make shapes your party’s combat style and exploration strategy.

Exploration and Puzzles Intertwined
This dungeon is not just a battleground—it is a massive puzzle box. Hidden switches, ancient carvings, scattered letters… every detail may hold the key to the next floor, or reveal a secret long buried beneath the stone.

The Dragon Knight’s Legacy
Legend says the Dragon Knight used the Artifact to seal the darkness beneath the dungeon. Now the Artifact is stolen, and the darkness is rising. Lured into the dungeon by a witch, you must find the Artifact before the dungeon claims you—and uncover the truth before it is lost forever.

games.name: EGGCONSOLE Harry Fox MSX Special MSX
Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
games.summary:
Welcome to Escape Academy, the world’s foremost clandestine educator in the art of Escape. Whether you’re a returning student or a new pupil, you’ve come to the right place. 

Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School evolves the escape room format of the first game into a whole new GENRE: This is the first open world escape room game, and it's available right in the comfort of your own home.

In Escape Academy 2, the campus is one big puzzle room. Between classes, explore a sprawling, secret-filled hub with mysterious passage ways, hidden tunnels, and dangerous traps. Or chill out with your pals and take in all the vibes that student life has to offer.

games.name: Faraway
games.summary: You are a shooting star that refuses its fate of disappearing in the ether, to instead go travel space and draw constellations through its journey. Faraway is a one-button game, with a simple set of rules finely balanced to adapt to different playing levels, within an always renewed universe that is procedurally generated in real time - based on score -, resulting in an infinitely replayable game. Like Steph Thirion's first game Eliss, Faraway is set in a bizarre and lonely outer space, was 100% created - design, coding, music and sound - by one person, and all its graphics are drawn by code, resulting in a rarely personal sensory experience.

games.name: FlipFlip Jigsaw DOUBLE-SIDE PUZZLE
games.summary:
Clear Both Sides♪ A New Double-Sided Flip Puzzle Featuring a Variety of Illustrations!

In addition to classic jigsaw puzzle gameplay, challenge yourself with a unique puzzle experience combining Rotate and Flip mechanics!
Featuring a variety of illustrations, including cute girls and adorable animals♪ Take your time, enjoy the artwork, and complete each puzzle at your own pace!
15 stages included!
As you progress, new mechanics and larger piece counts increase the challenge!
• Stages 1–5: Rotate Puzzles
• Stages 6–10: Double-Sided Flip Puzzles
• Stages 11–15: Double-Sided Flip + Rotate Puzzles
• Includes high-difficulty stages with up to 81 pieces × 2 sides!
In double-sided stages, you can complete either the front side or the back side first! How you solve each puzzle is entirely up to you♪
The final stage is an ultimate challenge with no background watermark hints! Carefully examine every piece and work your way toward completion!
A gallery featuring both front-side and back-side artwork is unlocked as you complete puzzles! Clear every stage and complete the entire gallery collection!

games.name: Gemporium
games.summary:
Mine, refine, and sell gemstones in Gemporium, a cute, fast-paced shop management game.

Grow your small gem business in this short, casual simulation miner, Gemporium! Manage your time wisely between mining gemstones, refining them for more profit, and selling them to awaiting customers. After your Grandmole goes on vacation, you’re in charge of running her shop, and you quickly learn it also comes with a price of massive debt. Now, on top of building your business, you must appease the Loan Shark without going broke!

Gemporium features a timed day cycle where you have to balance completing tasks and running the gem store. Each day consists of:

Mining
Explore deeper and deeper in the local mines to stock up on gems of different rarities. Utilize various mining tools to prevent cracks and maintain the highest quality product for your shop!

Refining
Polish and prepare your recent finds in the mine to convert those lumps of rock into something collectors adore! Unrefined gemstones sell for way less than their refined counterparts, so make sure to visit the refinement table before you set up shop.

games.name: GeoJelly
games.summary:
Born within unknown you instinctively seek for freedom as an experiment defect. 

In GeoJelly you have to find your way out of dystopian laboratory through platforming while avoiding traps and collecting keys necessary to push forward. 

Are you gonna find a way out?

games.name: GET FIT - Street Workout
games.summary:
Train with pro trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer, level, and routine - then jump into 30 minutes of intense full-body workout.

Turn fitness into a fun, motivating, and interactive experience.

Choose your personal trainer, select your level, and begin your custom fitness journey through structured workouts that keep you challenged and inspired.

Each session combines 7 different exercises, performed for 1 minute 30 seconds with short 30-second breaks — repeated twice for a full 28-minute workout plus warm-up. With over 100 exercises, there are endless variations to keep every session fresh.

Build your personal training schedule across weeks or months, earn rewards for staying consistent, and watch your strength and endurance grow. Each trainer brings unique energy, voice, and encouragement to help you stay motivated.

games.name: Guided Meditations - Calm Mind
games.summary:
Relax and quiet your mind with soothing, voice-guided meditations. Settle in, and be guided to a more peaceful place.

Take a moment for yourself. Guided Meditations brings calming, voice-led meditation to your console — a peaceful space to relax, de-stress, and reconnect with a quieter mind, whether you have ten minutes or twenty.

No experience needed. Just pick a session, choose your setting, and let a warm, soothing voice guide you gently through every breath. Sink into tranquil visuals and softly flowing ambient sound, designed to ease away the noise of the day.

Whether you're winding down before sleep, settling a busy mind, or simply carving out a little calm in your routine, this is your invitation to slow down and just be.

Features

Soothing voice-guided meditations for all experience levels
Two calming guide voices to choose from
Shorter and longer sessions to fit your time
Beautiful, tranquil backgrounds you can select
Gentle ambient music to deepen your calm
A simple, peaceful experience — sit back, breathe, and unwind

Find your calm, one breath at a time.

games.name: Hidden Cats in Beijing
games.summary: Explore Beijing and find over 840 hidden objects, including cats and characters. Find Special Cats, unlock 7 bonus stages with two coloring modes, and collect cards featuring Beijing landmarks and real cats from our community.

games.name: Hide & Hue
games.summary:
Paint to blend in, freeze, and hide — or switch sides and hunt.

Paint yourself. Freeze. Hope they walk past.
You are a small blank doll in a room full of colour. The seekers are on their way, and the only thing standing between you and a finger pointed at your head is the paint you put on your own body.
Every round is three moments.
Prepare. Grab a colour and paint yourself — panel by panel, or the whole doll at once. A palette of 48 shades is always at hand, and the eyedropper lifts the exact colour off a wall, a chair, a crate or the floor right beside you. Pick a pose — stand, sit, or curl into a ball — and squeeze in wherever a tall doll would never fit. Lock your body when you like the spot, so a nudge can't ruin it.
Hide. The seekers spread out and start searching. They look along their line of sight, get suspicious of anything that stands out, and close in to be sure. A good colour match buys you seconds of doubt. A bad one gets you caught standing in plain sight.
The result. Survive and you earn up to three stars — for how well your colour matched the place you chose, not just for hanging on. Get caught and the round starts over instantly, so you can go straight back in with a better idea.
Or turn it around and be the one searching. Choose to play as the seeker, wait while the hiders paint and tuck themselves away, then go find them. Walk up, look closely, and mark every doll you spot before the clock runs out. Clever hiders match the wall exactly and pick the darkest corner — careless ones give themselves away with the wrong shade.
Five places to disappear in.

games.name: K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine
games.summary: In K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine, players immerse themselves in the demanding and fascinating world of modern music. Accompanied by their best friend Nova, they will need to commit 100 percent to the race for stardom: from intensive training sessions in the studio to the ultimate recognition on the most prestigious stages, the title offers a complete experience combining a sense of rhythm, deep customization, and community management in the era of social media.

games.name: Kingdom of Night
games.summary:
One night, in 1987, in the small town of Miami, Arizona, a satanic cult unwittingly summons the ancient evil, Baphomet, catapulting the town into chaos. John, awoken by the kidnapping of his neighbor, sets out into the night to fight back against the demonic invasion and rescue his friends before it's too late...

Take control of John as his adventure leads him through an hour-by-hour experience of what could be everyone's last night on Earth. As John, you will encounter unearthly evils, Demon lords, afflicted townsfolk, high school bullies, and a torrent of engaging, serial-like side stories - all nested in a larger-than-life fantasy that brings the ultimate evil to a neighborhood near you.

Choose your class, customize your abilities, and battle nightmarish creatures as you collect unique gear in order to infiltrate the massive lairs of Demon lords that have taken over the town.

games.name: Lilac ~side Witch~
games.summary:
A fantasy visual novel set in a magic school where humans and mages mingle. Follow Emil, a young human who despises mages, and Henri, a self-proclaimed "bonehead" of a mage, as they learn how to connect in spite of various anxieties and differing backgrounds.

Features numerous beautiful characters designed by industry veteran Oyari Ashito!

The female main cast version ("Lilac -side Witch-") and the male main cast version ("Lilac -side Wizard-") contain different characters and voices. There are also small details unique to each story version.

games.name: Lilac ~side Wizard~
games.summary:
This is a tale of how mages and humans learn to connect.


A fantasy visual novel set in a magic school where humans and mages mingle. Follow Emil, a young human who despises mages, and Henri, a self-proclaimed "bonehead" of a mage, as they learn how to connect in spite of various anxieties and differing backgrounds.
Features numerous beautiful characters designed by industry veteran Oyari Ashito!


Lilac Academy.
A joint magic school established by Lilac, the Legendary Magus, who wished for a world where humans and mages could come together, hand in hand, in peace and harmony.
One day, in a rural village in the east, an admission letter arrives at the home of a sick mother and her child, Emil.
Having been treated badly by a mage in the past, Emil hates mages. However, upon learning that graduating from the academy would net a generous monetary reward, Emil resolves to enroll. The reason? Family comes before any grudge.
After getting lost on the way to the academy, Emil meets Henri, who happens to be around the same age. The two hit it off, but that all falls apart once Emil realizes that Henri is actually a mage.
Disgusted at this revelation, Emil tries to leave, but Henri insists on showing the way to the academy and forcibly casts a spell.
However, the spell fails, and Emil is sent flying to an unfamiliar place. Thus begins Emil's turbulent academy life.

games.name: Love n Life: Happy Student - Winter Embrace
MANIC MINER
games.summary:
Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! 

Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

games.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition
games.summary:
The critically-acclaimed, story-driven Marvel adventure, now optimized for Nintendo Switch 2.

Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.

The Encore Edition is exclusive to Switch 2 and includes a new set of outfits for Star-Lord, Drax, Gamora, Rocket and Groot. Dressed in 1980s glam rock threads, the Guardians are ready to bring down the house. Literally.

games.name: Minion's Revenge: Take Everything They Took
Needle In A Haystack 2026
games.summary:
Pull the straws. Sell the hay. Hire a crew, grab a rake. Find the needle in the haystack!

Somewhere in this haystack there is a needle. Your job is to find it, one straw at a time.

Needle In A Haystack 2026 is a relaxing first-person idle game set in a huge factory hall. Grab straws from the pile, drop them on the conveyor belt and watch the money roll in. Every straw you sell brings you closer to the needle hidden deep inside the stack.

Start small with your bare hands and the little Backyard Stack. Spend your earnings in the Workshop to carry more straws at once, get a better price for every straw and hire workers who dig through the hay while you search for the needle. When you are ready, take on The Great Haystack - a towering dome of more than 26,000 straws.

UPGRADE YOUR TOOLS
- Bigger hands: carry more straws on every trip
- Better buyer: earn more money for every straw
- Rake: sweep up a whole bunch of straws with one stroke
- Vacuum cleaner: suck straws straight out of the pile
- Metal detector: scan through the hay and listen for the needle. At the top level, an arrow points the way

games.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany
games.summary:
Do you have what it takes to catch "The Epiphany Killer"?

Step into the world of "Next of Kin: Epiphany," where you become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

In the thrilling conclusion to the "Next of Kin" trilogy, you'll explore atmospheric locations, interrogate suspects with the powerful new "Expose" system, and unravel the chilling truth behind the notorious "Epiphany Killer".

games.name: Phantom Floor
games.summary: You are trapped on the Phantom Floor. You must find a way to escape, but keep quiet, it's always listening.

games.name: Play & Learn My First Korean
games.summary:
See it. Fill in Hangul!

Can you recognize the right Korean word from a picture and its meaning?

If you are just starting out, learning a new language can feel intimidating. This game makes your first steps into Korean simple and fun.

Complete Korean words by filling in the blank with the correct Hangul. Illustrations and Japanese meanings help you understand familiar everyday words as you play.

How to play:
• Check the illustration and the Japanese meaning.
• Choose the correct Hangul from the answer choices.
• Complete the Korean word in the blank.

With 120 stages to play, you can gradually get used to Hangul letters and Korean vocabulary through a fun game-like experience.

Recommended for anyone who:
• Wants to start learning Korean
• Wants to learn Hangul in a fun way
• Wants to get familiar with Korean words
• Enjoys quizzes and fill-in-the-blank puzzles
• Wants to practice a language in short sessions

games.name: Primary School - English Grade 2
games.summary:
A full year of English adventures! Join 7 lovable characters, blast through countless topics, ace every quiz and become an English superstar.

Make learning English feel easy, structured, and fun. With 7 lovable characters, kids explore the full Grade 2 curriculum through guided lessons, interactive quizzes, and friendly explanations. Smart progress tracking and spaced repetition help strengthen long-term memory. Perfect for parents and children learning together — or for confident young learners practicing independently.

games.name: Puppet of Pain
games.summary:
Aim, shoot, throw, explode and laugh! Hit the silly puppet target with crazy weapons and funny reactions!

Welcome to the craziest carnival shooting gallery ever! Puppet of Pain is a hilarious action game where a hanging puppet swings in front of you, ready for nonstop chaos.

Take aim and hit the moving dummy with an enormous collection of wild weapons. Every shot, throw, or explosion makes the puppet wobble, spin, bounce, and react with funny screams, groans, and ridiculous sounds that make every hit even more entertaining.

Unlock a massive arsenal of weapons:

Pistols, rifles and machine guns
Shotguns, launchers and bazookas
Knives and other sharp throwing weapons
Fire-based weapons and explosives
Magic staves and cursed powers
Bows, crossbows and fantasy gear
Sci-fi lasers and energy blasters
Crazy surprise weapons

Every hit earns coins, allowing you to unlock even more tools of destruction.

games.name: Revenant : In Memory Of The Day
games.summary: You are heading down an endless corridor in search of a missing child. Pay close attention to your surroundings to find clues about the child, and find a way to escape the dark, confined corridor.

games.name: Shelterra the Skyworld
games.summary: Explore a floating continent in a fantasy JRPG! Journey across an open world, conquer dungeons in turn-based battles, learn new skills by fighting enemies, and summon powerful Artifacts to aid you. Uncover the secrets of the Skyworld and save Shelterra from falling!

games.name: Sleepless Night Mysteries: Unsolved Case Files
games.summary:
Can you crack these mysteries?

What secrets are waiting at the scene?

If you enjoy detective stories but want something easy to pick up, this mystery game lets anyone feel like a real investigator.

Search through unsolved cases, uncover hidden evidence, and piece together what really happened. Every case is a self-contained short story, so you can enjoy a complete mystery whenever you have a little time.

• Examine each scene carefully
• Find the evidence hidden in the case
• Use hints when you need a helping hand
• Follow the clues and reveal the truth

Helpful hints make the game welcoming for newcomers to mysteries and deduction, while careful observers can test their skills from the very first case.

Enjoy a quick mystery break, challenge your powers of observation, and try to solve each case before the answer comes to light!

games.name: Sora - Oasis Treasures
games.summary:
Embark on a breathtaking journey through the jungle skies in Sora - Oasis Treasures. Play as a vibrant parrot and soar across tropical islands, dense canopies, waterfalls, and ancient ruins. Your goal is simple yet meaningful: stay close to your flock as you all travel across the wild, untouched archipelago. 

Each of the handcrafted levels features 40–60 sky markers guiding your path as your flock leads the way. Fly through wind boosts to gain speed, discover hidden shortcuts, and enjoy the feeling of freedom as you glide above treetops and turquoise waters. The world is full of life and color, rewarding you with beautiful vistas and relaxing moments of harmony in flight. 
Though the skies are peaceful, you must stay alert—fall too far behind, and you risk losing the flock. Crashes don’t punish you harshly; you simply return to the most recent waypoint and continue your journey. The focus is on enjoying the adventure, soaking in the serene atmosphere, and experiencing the thrill of flying together. 

With smooth controls, gentle pacing, and vibrant flocks that vary in speed each run, every flight feels fresh. Whether you're racing through the breeze or drifting lazily over a jungle river, Sora - Oasis Treasures offers a warm, relaxing escape into tropical skies where unity and exploration take center stage

games.name: Stellar Blade: Complete Edition
games.summary:
The future of humanity is balanced on the edge of a blade. Ravaged by strange, powerful creatures, Earth has been abandoned, and what is left of the decimated human race has fled to a Colony in outer space.

After travelling from the Colony, EVE arrives on the desolate remains of our planet with a clear-cut mission: to save humankind by reclaiming Earth from the Naytiba - the malevolent force that has devastated it.

But as EVE tackles the Naytiba one-by-one, piecing together the mysteries of the past in the ruins of human civilization, she realizes that her mission is far from straightforward. In fact, almost nothing is as it seems...

Engage in blisteringly fast combat as you slash a path through the remnants of Earth. Unleash graceful yet brutal attacking combos, unlock new moves and weapon upgrades, and face epic boss encounters that will challenge both brain and brawn in equal measure.

Unravel a gripping human fate story, with mature themes, a thought-provoking narrative and emotionally-charged revelations from beginning to end.

games.name: The Crane Files: A Detective Mystery
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.summary: The battle for Hyrule begins. The evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the hero of time and save the kingdom in this classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch 2 system. Enjoy completely overhauled visuals, voiced cutscenes, expanded dialogue, and symphonic orchestral music. You can also jump and dash through the action with enhanced controls and modern camera movements, making this an excellent entry point into the Legend of Zelda™ series.

games.name: The Skull of the Howard Knight
Tidy Up the Library of Alexandria
Valkyrie Tune: Synthesis of Souls
games.summary: A visual novel that brings the "Valkyrie Tune" plastic model series by Good Smile Company to life. Experience the resonant story of an amnesiac protagonist and six stunning heroines, whose intertwining serenade of love, sorrow, and fateful encounters calls forth a reboot for the future.

games.name: Where the Seeds Fall
games.summary: - Fast pace gaming and easy to play- Wonderful graphics- Advanced multipliers mean you get the best wins possible- Auto Hold Feature: Video Poker Classic holds the cards for you! Our finely tuned auto algorithm determines your best chances at success and automatically holds your cards. You can change that of course and take a risk at grabbing the big bucksStart playing and be entertained for hours

games.name: Yomawari: Lost in the Dark
games.summary:
To break a curse placed upon her, a young girl must venture into the haunted streets of her town at night to search for her lost memories while evading
the twisted spirits that lurk in the darkness.

games.name: Yomawari: The Long Night Collection
games.summary: Twice the fright. Traverse the haunting world of Yomawari: Night Alone as a young girl searches for her sister, then share in the terror facing schoolgirls Yui and Haru in Yomawari: Midnight Shadows. Uncover the mysteries plaguing a rural Japanese town, hide from the things lurking in the night, and maybe get home alive.

games.name: Zeus Evolve Weapons Survivor: Greek Gods Versus Heaven
games.summary:
He built heaven. Now heaven wants him gone. Play as Zeus and survive the war he started!

Olympus has turned on its king.

Endless waves of divine soldiers, mythic beasts, and rival gods close in from every side, and they do not stop.

You are Zeus, the most powerful god in the Greek pantheon, walking alone through the kingdom he built as the sky itself turns against him.

Pick up weapons. Evolve them. Destroy everything.

games.name: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn
緋修羅 HIJURA SCARLET GEAR - ゾルゲステーション特別版 緋修羅特集
緋修羅 HIJURA SCARLET GEAR Soundtrack
Citizen Sleeper: Helion Collection
games.summary:
The Helion Collection brings together the award-winning Citizen Sleeper, a gripping adventure inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, which has you living the life of an escaped worker as you attempt to survive on a lawless space station and its sequel, Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector, a dice-driven RPG where you get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.
About Citizen Sleeper
Roleplaying in the ruins of interplanetary capitalism. Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, explore the station, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.
About Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
A dice-driven RPG, in a human and heartfelt sci-fi world. You are an escaped android, with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past. Get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.

games.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
games.summary:
Get ready for a big, colourful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Cluedo Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.

Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.

Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!

games.name: Pretty Girls Game Collection V
games.summary:
The latest entry in the popular compilation series brings together four fan-favourite Pretty Girls titles in one value-packed retail release, offering players a diverse selection of puzzle and casual gameplay experiences paired with the charming anime-style presentation that fans have come to expect from the franchise.

Each of the four games has been enhanced with exclusive naughty content, that fans of the series have become accustomed to, amounting to a wealth of new images direct from the Japanese creators that would otherwise not have been possible to release on console even in their home country, making this essential and definitive.

games.name: Seek
games.summary:
In this unique survival horror game, classical music intertwines with psychological terror to create an oppressive, chilling atmosphere. You play Alice, an ordinary girl who wakes up to find herself trapped in a bizarre, ever-changing world. A snowbound orphanage, monsters lurking in the shadows, and intricate puzzles—every step is fraught with danger and uncertainty.

To survive, you must gather supplies, evade pursuit, and uncover the secrets hidden in the darkness. But as the truth gradually comes to light, can you bear the cruel reality behind it all?

Gameplay features:
Action Shooting
Use a variety of firearms to defeat enemies

Map Exploration
Explore the eerie orphanage step by step, collecting items to unlock new areas while confronting unexplained changes that may occur without warning

Resource Management
Gather and make prudent use of limited resources, and do whatever it takes to survive

Puzzle Solving
Gather clues, solve a wide range of puzzles, and uncover the final truth

games.name: Just Dance: Decades of Hits
games.summary:
IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE SPANNING 6 DECADES
Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades.

DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWS
Celebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography, including fan-favorites like:

- "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny
- "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter
- "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo & Don Omar
- "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon
- "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz
- "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC
- "Wannabe" by Spice Girls
- "No Scrubs" by TLC
- "It's Tricky" by Run DMC
- "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel
- "Mamma Mia" by ABBA

games.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
games.summary:
Welcome to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom, the second expansion of MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, which includes two new playable characters and a new game mode.

Equipped with high-powered tech armor of his own design, along with occult skills and his genius intellect, Doctor Doom is the biggest threat in the universe... and Annihilus definitely won't be up to the challenge.

Cosmic rays have given archeologist and explorer Susan Storm massive light-bending powers and force field manipulation. She now fights for the survival of the galaxy as The Invisible Woman, bringing in never-seen-before abilities to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion.

MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom will put the leader of Latveria at the center of its new game mode, set in the nefarious Castle Doomstadt.

games.name: Monster Train 2: The Punished
games.summary: Turn pain into power with The Punished, a new clan joining the fight in Monster Train 2! Led by Archus, Darkness Incarnate, The Punished introduce a new risk-reward play style built around damaging your own units, harnessing their suffering, and turning it against your enemies.

games.name: RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition
games.summary:
RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos.

RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition blends the chaotic fun of classic arcade coin pushers with the element of roguelike deckbuilding. Combine special coins with powerful items to trigger satisfying synergies. It’s a nonstop dopamine rush packed into one unpredictable, coin dropping ride.

SYNERGIZING COINS & CHAOS
Discover all kinds of special coins during your runs! Combine Seed Coins with Water Coins to grow a money tree right inside your machine. Drop a Cat Coin to hunt down every last Rat Coin and rack up extra tickets. Need more points? Use a Multiply Coin to boost your score across the board. Too slow? Launch a Nuclear Coin to trigger a massive explosion and blast every coin forward at once!

CRAFT POWERFUL STRATEGIES WITH ITEMS
Stack multipliers, spawn coins with extra points, or simply shake the machine when you're running dry. Apply special plating to your favorite coins to enhance their effects and unlock even wilder combos.

DIFFERENT CHARACTERS, DISTINCT PLAYSTYLES
Play as one of several unique characters, each with their own set of themed coins and playstyle. Take on the role of a greedy raccoon manager who excels at math-based combos, or a quirky biologist who specializes in animal-based coins. Every character offers a fresh and wildly different way to play.

games.name: Shrek 2 Remastered
games.summary:
DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.

Improved graphics: Everything has been rebuilt with better textures, enhanced UI, 4K resolution and cutscenes.

New features: Create timeless snapshots using the new Photo Mode and unlock cheats in Cheat Mode to make your playthrough a seamless experience.

Up to 4-player Couch Co-op, Online or Mixed: A cozy, team-based co-op action-adventure game, playable solo or up to 4-Player Couch Co-Op, Online Multiplayer, and Mixed Online Multiplayer & Couch Co-Op.

Immersive levels straight out of a fairytale: From Shrek’s swamp to the castle of Far Far Away, relive iconic moments from the movie featuring beloved characters and hidden Easter Eggs.

Swap heroes at any time: Swap your hero to battle enemies, conquer bosses, and solve environmental puzzles using their unique abilities to advance in the story.

games.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
games.summary:
The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends.

Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary:
Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors' game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. 

Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton.

games.name: Castlebound
games.summary:
Castlebound is a thrilling roguelike action game where you and your allies must defend a walking castle while battling relentless waves of monstrous foes.

Join Lenora, a skilled archer, and her wise grandfather Vargus as they awaken an ancient structure that transforms into a living fortress.

Guided by the enigmatic Coronya, they must gather powerful warriors to fight the malevolent forces threatening the realm.

games.name: Hope in the City
games.summary:
17-year-old Hope Song thought the national exams were her biggest worry... until she got home to a ransacked apartment and two missing parents. Investigate through the eyes of an artist, turn sketches into evidence, and watch her family's mystery grow stranger and darker with every answer.

Hope in the City is a narrative mystery game, set in the Chinese city of Shenyang, by the team behind the 2026 GDC Best in Play Winner Sky of Tides and the Annie Award-nominated Eternal Spring. Play as Hope, a 17-year-old girl investigating her parents' disappearance, connecting the clues and uncovering the truth hidden beneath the city's calm.

NO NOTE NO WARNING
You come home from school like any other day. But the house is too quiet. Your parents are gone, the apartment is in shambles. No note, no warning, no answer. Hope Song is 17, and she's just become the only person willing to ask what really happened.

AN ARTIST’S EYE
Hope isn't a detective. She's an artist. And that's exactly what makes her dangerous to whoever's hiding the truth. Every room holds details that don't add up: a shadow in the wrong place, an object that shouldn't be there, a lie in someone's eyes.

Capture what you see as sketches in Hope's notebook. Every detail matters.

FROM OBSERVATION TO TRUTH
Connect what you've seen into insights, and push those insights until they crack open into breakthroughs. Piece by piece, sketch by sketch, the picture of what happened to your parents starts to take shape, and it's darker than you imagined.

A CITY FULL OF SECRETS
Shenyang isn't just a backdrop, it's a character of its own. Rendered in a bold, stylized art style with an edge, every street, storefront, and shadowed alley is begging to be explored. Wander past neon signs and quiet corners alike, and let the city's striking visuals pull you deeper into its secrets.

WHO CAN YOU TRUST?
On the surface, it's just home: familiar streets, quiet neighbors, ordinary life. But beneath Hope's peaceful existence, secrets are buried. And now it's her time to find the truth.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon
games.summary:
You’re used to the lift descending into the depths of the pit – but now it’s going up. In this massive expansion for smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite BALL x PIT, rise above the abyss to reach Risen Ballbylon, which floats high in the sky above. Each level is a layer of the former city, where the population has been warped by the effects of the meteor.

Risen Ballbylon is the biggest and most transformative expansion for BALL x PIT yet, adding a wealth of new characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, buildings, and levels, dramatically expanding the possibilities of a run and introducing fresh new gameplay mechanics to test even the most hardened veterans of the pit. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Fakin' It XL
games.summary:
Fakin’ It XL is all about lying your way to victory. Each round presents a simple prompt to all players on their phone or device like “raise your hand if you’ve ever pretended to like a gift you hated.” Everyone is on the same page – except for the faker, who must act as if they’ve received the same prompt as everyone else. Blend in by bluffing, grilling and deflecting through three rounds of interrogation to rack up points. Who knew that casting suspicion on others could be so personally rewarding?

Fakin’ It XL Features:

    New Hijinks-fueling Questions: Emojinal Damage and Thumb Luck mix things up alongside classic Fakin’ It question types for maximum friend-deceiving scheming:
    Emojional Damage challenges players to phrase their answers in the form of an emoji, such as “the emoji for a perfect gift for your boss” while the Faker only has a general category, like “the emoji of an object.” Now, can the Faker explain why giving their boss a shoe is a great idea.
    Thumb Luck asks everyone to weigh in with a quick thumbs up or down on three opinion-worthy items in a row, like “Working from Home” or “Dogs in Costumes”. The Faker has to choose without knowing the subject, though—can they justify their support for “Singing Along With Musicals”?
    Enhanced Remote Play: New options let your avatar take action for you, so the game works just as well on a video call as it does in your living room.
    XL-sized Parties: Now up to eight players can join the same game, making for the rowdiest Fakin’ It sessions ever. Good thing there’s plenty of new avatar choices for everyone to choose from, too.

games.name: Gennady
games.summary: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer, where you must fight your way through shifting corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in the legendary absurdity and classic animation inspired by the era of Earthworm Jim.

games.name: Harold Halibut
games.summary:
Harold Halibut is a handmade narrative game about friendship, and life on a city-sized spaceship submerged in an alien ocean. 

It's been 250 years since your home - an ark-like spaceship - fled an Earth on the verge of cold war to find a habitable planet on which to preserve the human race. 
You are Harold, a young lab assistant for the ship's lead scientist, Jeanne Mareaux. While most of the ship's inhabitants have reconciled themselves to a life lived aboard the sunken ship, Mareaux still works tirelessly to find a way for the ship to leave the planet and find a new, dryer home. 

But of course the weird, wonderful and diverse people of the Fedora keep Harold busy too. Until one fateful encounter plunges Harold into a new world that nobody could have guessed existed - and one that may hold the key to Mareaux's re-launch plans. 

Join Harold as he explores a vibrant retro-future world, talks (with full voice acting) to its inhabitants, and occasionally goes hands on by sticking screwdrivers in things, operating complex machinery, and more in his quest to find the true meaning of 'home'.

games.name: Hazard Levels
games.summary:
The deeper the rift, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders.

Hazard Levels is a brand new co-op survival horror from the team behind Sker Ritual.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
games.summary:
From the creative minds behind Persona 3, 4, and 5 comes Metaphor: ReFantazio, a unique fantasy world, where your protagonist will journey alongside his fairy companion, Gallica, to lift the curse from the kingdom’s lost prince. Control your destiny, face your fears and awaken magical "Archetype" powers that lie dormant in your heart. By awakening to an “Archetype,” you will unlock the power to channel and combine the abilities of unique job classes. Strengthen your bonds and build your party to take down powerful foes and discover the kingdom’s true nature.

-Go on uests, dungeon dive, & hunt for treasures by day. Strengthen relationships, build bonds, & increase virtues by night. Choose your actions wisely, time management is key to achieving your goal. 

Ride your “gauntlet runner” to faraway dungeons & towns across an expansive world. Discover beautiful landscapes  accompanied by captivating music, immersive UI, & anime cutscenes.

A unique battle system combining turn based & real time action grants strategy & exhilaration at every turn. Party customization through “Archetypes” provides freedom to personalize your adventure. 

A mysterious & exciting story unfolds in a world where people must fight their own anxiety. Join the high-stakes Royal Tournament that promises hours of captivating exploration and discovery.

games.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
games.summary:
Moomin: Midsummer Madness is a delightfully playful point-and-click adventure inspired by Tove Jansson’s cherished Nordic fantasy novel, Moominsummer Madness. 

Play as Moomintroll and Little My as they explore a curious old theatre caught in a great flood. The journey will be filled with endearing encounters, familiar faces, and a touch of mischief.

games.name: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
games.summary:
Guide plantlike Pikmin on an enhanced expedition!

Meet Pikmin: small, plantlike creatures you can grow, pluck, guide, and send into battle with creatures multiple times their size! These loyal, curious helpers come in different types, including fire-resistant Red Pikmin, Ice Pikmin that can freeze bodies of water, and Glow Pikmin that can light the way forward at night. 

Dandori is the art of commanding your Pikmin effectively, and sometimes explorers like to get in on some friendly competition.

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of the game features Dandori Academy, an extensive series of Dandori exam stages for you to test your skill and earn in-game medals! A total of 72 stages will be released over time - and they vary in difficulty, so you can choose the ones that match your skill level.

games.name: Sonic Pico Park
games.summary:
The latest entry in the PICO PARK series is a collaboration with SEGA's Sonic the Hedgehog!

Sonic the Hedgehog, celebrating its 35th anniversary this year, joins the latest entry in the PICO PARK series, a series that has sold over 8 million copies worldwide.

PICO CAT, the iconic character of the PICO PARK series, races through the world of PICO PARK with Sonic, the world’s fastest hedgehog, and his friends, including Tails, Knuckles, and Amy.

games.name: Supermarket Simulator
games.summary:
Run your own supermarket. Stock shelves, handle cashier tasks, process online orders, design & expand. Set the prices based on the market. 

In "Supermarket Simulator", every decision matters. Will you rise to the occasion, transforming a modest establishment into a retail powerhouse, all while balancing customer satisfaction, finances, and mafia expectations?

games.name: Weed Supermarket Simulator
games.summary: Weed Supermarket Simulator is a chill store sim where you grow weed, develop new strains, set prices, and keep your shelves stocked. Expand your business and optimize it for maximum profit. Manage employees, handle inventory, and turn your shop into a high-performing business.

games.name: Leaf Blower Co.
games.summary:
Blow your leaves and your cares away in this chilled out work sim. Build up your business, buy new tools, and unlock upgrades - all while watching the leaves fly. After all, one man’s trash is another man’s cash.

Play through the full story of Leaf Blower Co., clear away clutter and bring back a world of peace and tranquillity. And of course, no-one expects you to do all of this for free! Spend your hard-earned cash on new gear, upgrades, and even new styles. It’s important to have the right tool for the job, and if you don’t do it, who else is gonna skin your bin?

games.name: Ravenswatch
games.summary:
Ravenswatch is a top-down roguelike action game that combines intense real-time combat with deep gameplay and high replay value.

After the success of Curse of the Dead Gods, Passtech returns with a new formula and game experience that can be played solo or with up to four players in co-op.

To defeat the Nightmare and reach the final chapter, you will need a strong build, focus and excellent teamwork. Increase your fighting power in battles then face the level boss when you feel ready... or when you no longer have a choice.

games.name: Spirit Crossing
games.summary:
Prepare to adventure into a joyful world with Spirit Crossing, a massively cooperative life sim designed to encourage friendship and make the world feel a little less lonely.

From award-winning cozy games studio Spry Fox, journey through an ever-changing landscape as you spread kindness throughout a vibrant, inviting community.

games.name: Moonlight Peaks
games.summary: Welcome to your new vampiric life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks. Raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, and befriend – or even romance – the local werewolves, witches, and mermaids in this heartwarming supernatural life-sim. Eternity awaits!

games.name: Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator
games.summary:
In Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator, you take on the everyday responsibilities of a real park ranger in the stunning Faremont National Park. Restore and maintain scenic trails, assist visitors, and document wildlife in a living, breathing ecosystem.

You’ll clear blocked paths, collect litter, fix broken signs - and occasionally drop everything to respond to urgent wildlife sightings or missing hikers. Each day brings new tasks and surprises.

Faremont’s diverse biomes range from dense forests and meadows to winding rivers. With your ranger pickup, you’ll cover long distances along the park’s road network, reaching remote areas filled with natural landmarks like waterfalls, rock formations, and scenic viewpoints.

As you explore, use your camera to observe animal behavior and expand your personal wildlife lexicon. From elusive wolves and majestic eagles to mischievous raccoons, each species adds life to the park’s biological habitat.

games.name: Dark Rail
games.summary: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
games.summary:
Get ready to dive into an entirely new adventure as you become a magical Merfolk and embark on a sweeping journey across the sea to reach a faraway kingdom, where strange echoes of its past await. Along the way, you’ll meet some unforgettable new friends, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara, as you uncover the mysteries waiting beyond the waves.

The Keepsake Sea will introduce brand-new Biomes to explore, mysterious underwater areas to uncover, and new spaces to fully customize. From exploring what lies beneath the surface to discovering the secrets of this faraway kingdom, there’s plenty of adventure waiting for you!

games.name: Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld
games.summary:
Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings. 

Did you manage to save the Multiverse AND survive the apocalypse?

Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, watch them puke, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards. 

Sounds like vacation to me. 

Secure your ticket today, enjoy the dizziness later.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.summary: With development of the next entry in the Grand Theft Auto series well underway, the Rockstar Games team is determined to once again set creative benchmarks for the series, our industry, and for all entertainment, just as the label has done with every one of their frontline releases.

games.name: Lost Sock Simulator 3000
games.summary: Be a sweetheart and help Gertrude Knitmore find all her lost socks. An idle clicker about humanity's oldest unsolved mystery. And yes, there's an ending. The universe has opinions about your sock collection.

games.name: Reverie in the Moonlight
games.summary: In Reverie in the Moonlight, scary monsters are chasing you, and you can’t fight them...but your plushies can. Can your adorable friends protect you from these nightmares?

games.name: Sumikkogurashi Welcome to Poka Poka Onsen
games.summary:
In this game, you will work with the Sumikko characters to help out at a busy hot spring inn that is short-staffed, aiming to make it a popular inn where everyone can gather. You will work hard at various jobs such as guiding guests and cleaning, adding new facilities and making it a wonderful hot spring inn.

Use the coins that guests earn by using the facilities to open shops, game corners, and more to develop the inn. The more facilities you add and the higher your level, the more coins you earn, and the more facilities you can open! You can enjoy the excitement of expanding your possibilities and the sense of accomplishment as your inn becomes more lively.

This game offers endless fun and replayability. In this game, you'll experience the satisfaction of gradually expanding a quiet hot spring inn into a vibrant place, while enjoying a relaxing hot spring life with the comical and adorable Sumikko characters.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance + Online
games.summary:
For the first time ever on console, descend together. The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ brings the complete game to console with full online cooperative play for up to four players. Every character, every item, every path, every ending, now with friends online.

Key Features

    Full online cooperative play for up to four players, on console.
    The complete game: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth plus all downloadable content (“Afterbirth,” “Afterbirth+,” “Repentance,” and “Repentance+”).
    Hundreds of items, dozens of characters and endlessly randomized runs.
    Rebalanced items and improvements from years of updates.

games.name: Tanks Sweet Tanks
games.summary:
It’s fast. It’s fun. It’s addicting. 

Deafest the enemy tanks while dodging their deadly bullets. 
Improve your aim and maneuver skill while war itself is trying to end your adventure. 
Level by level the enemy's tanks get faster, smarter, and deadlier. 
Can you make it to the end and defeat their leader? 

Play alone. Play with your friends. Play against your friends. 

- Play the single-player campaign to practice your skills and beat the game by yourself. 
- Finish the campaign with 2 players in the co-op mode. 
- Defeat your friends in the VS Mode for up to 4 players.

games.name: Final Kick Football Legends
games.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

games.name: Gothic 3
games.summary: You have saved the island Khorinis from the forces of evil in Gothic I and Gothic II. Now it is time to travel to the realms of the mainland. Invading Orcs have enslaved the human kingdom. There are but a few free humans in the icy north and the southern desert and a handful of rebels hiding in the forests and mountains of Midland. You may either join the rebellion or serve the Orcish Usurpers but you will ultimately tip the scales and decide the outcome of the last war to save humanity. There is no simple linear story in Gothic III - every game will be different and unique - but all will ultimately lead to you deciding the fate of Myrtana.

games.name: Sunstone of Time
games.summary:
Step into the role of a brilliant young scientist whose fascination with ancient relics leads to an unexpected journey through history. Sunstone of Time is a historical VR odyssey where exploration, secret discovery, and intricate puzzle-solving are your keys to survival in the vibrant world of the Aztecs, and your only hope of returning home!

After a groundbreaking experiment goes awry, you awaken in a distant past, thrust into an unfamiliar era. Explore breathtaking temples, ancient settlements, and sacred sites. Piece together forgotten knowledge, interact with a vibrant world, and meet unique characters, each with their own stories and motives. But danger lurks in the shadows: a powerful high priest is weaving dark schemes that threaten not only your fate, but the future of the entire world. Only your intelligence, courage, and insatiable curiosity can guide you through this ancient labyrinth of challenges.

Unravel a rich and engaging story as every step brings you closer to understanding Aztec culture and uncovering the path back to your own time. Will you rise to the challenge, reshape your destiny, and save the world?

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary:
A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. 

This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Bulbo's Belief System
games.summary:
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told - learning allows him to see, move, and interact, but forgetting is just as important.

Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity to walk across gaps, and manage conflicting beliefs to solve mind-bending challenges. Experiment with what Bulbo knows (or doesn't) to navigate a world where perception shapes reality.

Can you control what Bulbo learns and unlearns to reach the goal?

games.name: Danger Mouse
games.summary:
Baron Greenback has fallen on hard times...

Feeling nostalgic for the “bad old days,” Greenback launches his boldest evil plan yet, forcing Danger Mouse and Penfold to re-live all their epic encounters. 

Will Greenback get a second chance at victory, or is this the final game over?

games.name: GrimKeep
games.summary:
The city is lost. From the castle at its center an evil spreads, changing everyone into wretched parodies of life. Desolate streets infested with monsters, perpetually dark skies threaten to spread across the land.

Be the hero, reach the GrimKeep and end the source of evil; the Princess.

In a world of fairy tales turned nightmares, GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder that challenges you to master both luck and strategy. Collect powerful relics, forge unstoppable synergies, and battle through a city consumed by darkness.

games.name: Winx Club: Moonlight Quest
games.summary:
Winx Club – Moonlight Quest is a brand-new video game adventure that allows players to experience the magical universe of Winx Club through exploration, flight, action and a wide variety of mini-games.

Take control of Bloom, transform at will, explore iconic locations from the ground and the skies, master magical powers and uncover the secrets surrounding the mysterious Festival of the 100 Moons.

Alongside the main adventure, players can enjoy 32 mini-games across four game modes and play as 24 characters from the Winx Club universe.

games.name: Dune: Awakening - Blood and Ice
games.summary:
The Polar Sink map features two distinct biomes: the tundra and the ice cap. Players begin in the tundra, where wealthy water shipper families defend their lavish strongholds. Beyond lies the heavily guarded ice cap, where securing access to ice becomes a central goal.

Equipment built for the desert heat will need upgrading to withstand the cold. With the action returning to the ground, traversal, temperature management, and combat become essential to progression. Resources found only in the Polar Sink will allow players to craft the gear they need to survive.

The new map offers around 35 hours of progression, with opportunities to return for valuable resources. Harvested ice can cool base equipment and speed up production, while the free expansion also introduces new vehicle modules, augments, and specialization traits. Future updates will add further reasons to revisit the region.

games.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
games.summary:
Get ready for a cozy journey in "Hela", where you'll step into the tiny paws of a brave mouse, the beloved familiar of a witch who needs your help. 

Wander through an enchanting Scandinavian landscape filled with puzzles to solve, potions to brew, and quests to complete, all to aid your ailing witch. Whether you play alone or with friends, you're in for a treat filled with magic, companionship, and loads of charm.

"Hela" offers a delightful mix of adventure and relaxation. Enjoy exploring vast, open spaces, engaging in light-hearted play, and experiencing the simple pleasure of being a part of a caring community.

games.name: Luma Island
games.summary:
Travel to Luma Island to go on an epic adventure by yourself or with your friends and family. 

Begin your extraordinary journey in a humble old caravan and rise to the grand achievement of building a majestic manor that you can proudly call your home.

Traverse the island solving quests and helping the locals through their struggles. Dangerous spider caves, ancient temples, mind-bending puzzles and hidden treasures await you!

Pick from seven unique in-depth professions each with its own progression path. Upgrade your tools to gather rare materials and collaborate with your teammates to become the masters of your crafts.

games.name: The Ascent: Ultimate Edition
games.summary:
The Ascent is a solo and co-op Action-shooter RPG set in a cyberpunk world. 

You play as a worker enslaved by The Ascent Group, a corporate-run metropolis stretching high into the sky and filled with creatures from all over the galaxy. You must take up arms and embark on a new mission to find out what started it all.

games.name: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily
games.summary: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. Framed for murdering the Emperor, villainess Scarlet and Lily, fight the Empire as the first Streamers in history. Capture every enemy and turn them into allies for a happy ending... Or execute everyone and become the Demon Queen!

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.summary:
Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania focused on fast-paced combat, exploration, and an engaging story. The sequel to Aeterna Noctis follows the steps of its predecessor including a brand new protagonist and a large interconnected world! 

After the events of the first game, the Queen of Light must stop the destruction of the very existence by challenging the Supreme God Chaos while seeking the location of their old nemesis.

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: E.S.D.E.
games.summary:
Humanity is on the brink of extinction. Most of the population has disappeared, and those who remain have transformed into strange, soulless anomalies creatures that were once human and have now become a terrifying, unknown threat.

Every expedition is a gamble.
One mistake could be your last.

In E.S.D.E., every expedition is a high-stakes gamble. Explore six different zones, from massive apartment complexes to an old school, and recover valuable items that you can sell to merchants to fund your next runs. Face seven types of anomalies, each with unique behaviors.
 
Every expedition puts you at risk, so stay alert. If something is lurking nearby, put on your mask quickly and make sure it doesn't spot you. You'll be on your own for most of your time in these dangerous zones.

Every threat looks different.
Learn to recognize them before it's too late.

Explore six distinct zones, recover valuable items,
and live to tell the tale.

Wearing your mask could be crucial to keeping certain anomalies from detecting you.

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary:
The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples - so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination - now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

But saving a world already doomed is no easy task. With the help of Ysoris, her unlikely mentor, and Kanta, shaman prince of a lost tribe, Eline must overcome the formidable adversaries standing in her way.

games.name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
games.summary: Hello! Bouncy Bernard is a cute doggy that likes fun a lot. Puzzles is one of his favorite. However, this is not only about fun. He is very smart and is fond of discovering the world as well. He invites you to accompany him in doing this. Today he wants to be with you to discover striking representations of well-known racing cars and vehicles. There are Formula 1 car, motorcycles, NASCAR racing cars, rally cars, monster trucks, snowmobiles and water scooters. So, as you can see there is huge collection of objects to became familiar with and have fun in playing puzzles along with Bouncy Bernard. Don’t wait any longer! Main features: - Interactive puzzles parts for children aged 3+. - Three levels of difficulty (6 parts, 12 parts, 20 parts puzzles). - Beautiful and realistic 3D pictures that are created to both entertain and educate children. - Intuitive navigation. - Drag and drop puzzle pieces. Tap a piece to make it large, move into the place of destination and release. - Gray, faded picture background facilitating matching pieces. - Supporting sound effects. - Switch on / off music function.

games.name: Fall Up
games.summary:
Leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with the adorable Labi! Use a wide range of jumps and moves to traverse this colorful cartoon world, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots, and uncover its hidden secrets.

GAMEPLAY

Labi is all about powerful, precise jumps!

Installing a thruster module instead of a mobility module by mistake gave Labi the shortest yet most powerful legs of any robot. With those mighty legs, Labi can perform a Leg Launch and blast off like a cannonball, Stomp enemies with tremendous force, or spring off walls.

And it gets even better! Once Labi finds the Warp Ball, you can instantly teleport to wherever it lands. To overcome obstacles and solve puzzles, plan your route carefully and combine Running, Stomping, Dashing, and Double Jumping to find the best way forward. When danger strikes, Dash like a ninja and rely on your quick reflexes to dodge whatever comes your way.

GOALS

The core directive of Labi’s program: seek FREEDOM!

Collect Batteries scattered throughout each level. Some lie in plain sight along the main path, while others require a little extra exploration. At the end of each level, you will receive Gems based on the number of Batteries you collected. Gather enough Gems to unlock new areas.

Collect every Battery in a level to unlock its Time Trial. Complete the challenge to earn the level’s final Gem—a worthy prize for serious challengers!

games.name: FreeStyle Football 2
games.summary:
In FreeStyle Football 2, each of the 12 characters available at launch will feature unique skills that dramatically shape playstyles, whether it’s delivering lightning-fast passes, boosting teammates’ morale, or unleashing a power shot at the perfect moment. Every match is about teamwork, precise coordination, and tactical depth, with players controlling one character each in intense five-versus-five online battles.

The game will be available in multiple editions, including Basic, Premium, Deluxe, and Limited Club Edition, with monetization through a familiar console framework of Season Passes, downloadable content, and ongoing content updates.

games.name: House Flipper 2: Pets
games.summary:
Welcome to Puffin Isle! This slightly neglected region of Pinnacove seems in urgent need of a makeover. From charming villas to forgotten landmarks, these jobs are sure to surprise you! 

Meeting friends old and new, can you help them make this place a cozy haven for all animal lovers? Or will you focus on creating your own pet-centered houses for other players to enjoy?

Learn more about different breeds and species, observe them, and fulfill their needs to see them thrive. Let one of your cats or dogs accompany you during renovations and watch your friends pet them together in the co-op mode. Relax after a day of hard work by playing with your little companions and forge a bond that will last a lifetime.

games.name: Million Depth
games.summary: Craft original weapons and engage in strategic time-freezing battles as you dive into the million-floor deep underground world of this deep-diving action strategy game.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
